title: A growable array with realloc
summary: malloc/realloc/free, doubling growth, and leak-free ownership (ASan + LeakSanitizer).
hints: Never write `v->data = realloc(v->data, ...)`. If realloc fails it returns NULL and you lose the old block (a leak). Store the result in a temporary first.
`vec_free` must call `free(v->data)` and reset all three fields. LeakSanitizer fails the test if any block is still allocated at exit.
